title: Movix v2.3.0 - Working Multi-Audio Dubs & 100% White Banner Elimination
changelog: 100% Elimination of White Banners: Permanently fixed the white banner covering the home screen by removing rogue AdSense auto-ads and keeping native AdMob overlays transparent and non-intrusive

Working Multi-Language Dubbed Playback: Resolved audio language switching across Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada, and English powered by VidLink Pro 4K Multi-Audio and CineSrc Regional Dubs with automatic dub server routing
Exact-Second Audio Switch Continuity: Switching audio language preserves exact playback timestamp without resetting movie to 0:00

Butter-Smooth Portrait to Horizontal (Landscape) Rotation: Hardware-accelerated seamless rotation (ROTATION_ANIMATION_SEAMLESS) with zero layout thrashing, eliminating black screen flickers, aspect ratio distortion, and system bar flashes
100% Clean Google Play Protect Security: Completely eliminated 'Harmful App' warnings by removing high-risk dropper permissions (REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES)

Ad-Free Player Controls: Completely removed ads when interacting with player controls (close button, VIP button, server switcher, audio track switcher, orientation rotate); ads strictly play only before starting movie playback
Strengthened Anti-Ad Redirection in WebView: Strictly blocked rogue third-party iframe ad popups and top-level redirects from hijacking the app
Direct In-App OTA Update Installer: 1-tap in-app package installer launch with real-time download percentage progress
